subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should yielded cron parents introduce a permanent public `deferred` status across persisted state, Gateway protocol, CLI/UI, hooks, and plugin SDK, or remain an internal waiting state projected through existing public statuses?
rationale: The bug requires a waiting lifecycle, but this branch turns that state into a new compatibility-sensitive public contract that cannot be accepted solely from implementation correctness.

options.title: Keep public `deferred`
options.body: Approve the new status after all projections settle consistently and fresh-install plus upgrade proof covers persisted rows and external consumers.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Represent yielded-parent waiting inside the canonical lifecycle and task model while preserving the existing public cron status union.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land internal lifecycle and Discord/cron correctness fixes first, then decide the public status contract separately.

recommendation.title: Keep public `deferred`
recommendation.body: Approve the new status after all projections settle consistently and fresh-install plus upgrade proof covers persisted rows and external consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing yielded-subagent pause behavior and has the strongest recent history across the affected lifecycle boundaries.
